title: Brick Calculator
benefit: Bricks and Mortar for a Wall
cardBlurb: Bricks and mortar for a garden wall or veneer
metaDescription: Estimate modular bricks and cubic feet of mortar for a garden wall or brick veneer in feet, using Brick Industry Association figures and waste allowances.
secondaryKeywords: how many bricks do i need
intent: Estimate bricks and mortar for a brick veneer or garden wall.
registerRow: Not on the Oct 2026 Keyword Register: category-fill addition (Garden Walls) chosen by the redesign brief; clay or concrete brick and mortar, distinct from segmental retaining wall block.
intro: Enter a wall's length and height to get modular bricks and mortar to buy, using the Brick Industry Association's estimating figures and waste allowances.
chartTitle: Bricks in the wall vs waste allowance
diagramCaption: Wall elevation in running bond with the brick module. It redraws as you type.
uniqueAddition: Brick and mortar together for a wall or veneer from BIA Technical Note 10 figures (6.75 modular bricks per sq ft, 8.1 cu ft of mortar per 1,000 bricks, 5% brick and 15 to 25% mortar waste), with a one- or two-wythe option, clearly separate from the retaining-wall block tool.

inputs.name: openings
inputs.label: Openings
inputs.help: Windows, doors, or gaps the brick skips.

inputs.name: wythes
inputs.label: Thickness
inputs.help: A wythe is one brick-thick layer.

inputs.name: brickType
inputs.label: Brick size

options.label: Other size: enter your own figures

inputs.help: Modular brick is 7 5/8 × 2 1/4 × 3 5/8 in, laid with 3/8 in joints.

inputs.name: bricksPerSqFt
inputs.label: Bricks per sq ft of wall
inputs.help: From your brick maker or BIA Technical Note 10, 1 to 20.

inputs.name: mortarPer1000
inputs.label: Mortar per 1,000 bricks
inputs.help: From BIA Technical Note 10 for your brick and joint size, 1 to 40.

inputs.name: brickWaste
inputs.label: Brick waste
inputs.help: 0 to 25%. BIA says to add at least 5% for breakage and waste.

inputs.name: mortarWaste
inputs.label: Mortar waste
inputs.help: 0 to 50%. BIA says to add 15 to 25% to net mortar; 20% is the middle of that range.

sources.title: Technical Notes on Brick Construction 10, Dimensioning and Estimating Brick Masonry (Brick Industry Association, February 2009): Table 4, modular brick with 3/8 in joints, 6.75 per sq ft and 8.1 cu ft mortar per 1,000 brick; waste allowances
